commit 6ff59a4f3166e96489359834420564a15473345f
Author: Jaehoon You <158752+teslamint@users.noreply.github.com>
Date:   Wed Sep 16 14:52:58 2026 +0900

    feat(integrations): capture omp sessions without the Claude Code hook protocol
    
    omp exposes its own extension events instead of Claude Code's stdin hooks, so EC
    recorded nothing from omp sessions. The plugin maps session_start, before_agent_start,
    tool_result, turn_end and session_shutdown onto ec hook handle, chains every call for a
    session through one FIFO so PostToolUse always lands before the Stop that completes the
    turn, and feeds surfaced context back as a custom message (parsing the UserPromptSubmit
    hookSpecificOutput envelope). Installed via omp plugin link so the same package root also
    exposes .mcp.json.
    
    Constraint: EC hook handlers read cwd/prompt keys and hardcode session_type=claude; src/ untouched
    Rejected: tool_call event for PostToolUse | pre-execution, no result, throws fail-close the tool
    Rejected: raw symlink into ~/.omp/agent/extensions | loads the extension but never .mcp.json
    Rejected: ec omp install CLI command | a src/ behavior change would require Spec/ADR/Plan gate
    Confidence: high
    Scope-risk: narrow
    Directive: never park a backup copy inside ~/.omp/agent/extensions; one-level scan reloads it
    Tested: tsc clean; verify.sh replays real emitted payloads through ec hook handle 3x PASS; live omp session wrote one sessions row with total_turns=1; full pytest 2398 passed
    Not-tested: .mcp.json runtime discovery via /mcp list; host awaiting session_shutdown handler; assistant_summary stays empty (no transcript_path)
    Assisted-by: Claude Fable 5.1 with Oh My Pi

content.text: [{"title":"Bridge omp to EC capture through an out-of-tree plugin that shells out to `ec hook handle`","rationale":"EC capture depends on a host invoking `ec hook handle --type <HookType>` with a JSON payload on stdin. omp does not speak the Claude Code hook protocol; it exposes its own extension API (`session_start`, `before_agent_start`, `tool_result`, `turn_end`, `session_shutdown`), so EC recorded nothing from omp sessions. `integrations/omp/extension/index.ts` maps omp's events onto the existing hook protocol, leaving `src/` untouched. Consequence of the constraint: EC handlers read `cwd`/`prompt` keys, and `session_lifecycle.py:108` hardcodes `session_type=\"claude\"`, so omp sessions are recorded as `session_type='claude'`.","scope":"integrations/omp/extension/index.ts, integrations/omp/README.md","rejected_alternatives":[{"alternative":"Add an `ec omp install` CLI command","reason":"A `src/` behavior change would require the Spec/ADR/Plan gate."}]},{"title":"Map omp's `tool_result` event to the `PostToolUse` hook instead of `tool_call`","rationale":"`tool_result` is the documented post-execution event carrying `toolName`/`input`, which is what `PostToolUse` handlers consume (`turn_capture.py:297-300`).","scope":"integrations/omp/extension/index.ts","rejected_alternatives":[{"alternative":"Use the `tool_call` event for `PostToolUse`","reason":"It is pre-execution and carries no result; throws from it fail-close the tool."}]},{"title":"Serialize every hook invocation for a session through a single per-session FIFO queue","rationale":"EC's turn state machine requires `PostToolUse` to land before the `Stop` that completes the turn: `on_tool_use` only updates an `in_progress` turn, and `on_stop` flips it to `completed`. omp fires `tool_result` and `turn_end` independently with no ordering guarantee, so all calls for one session are chained through `sessionQueues`.","scope":"integrations/omp/extension/index.ts","rejected_alternatives":[{"alternative":"Spawn each hook call independently, without cross-event ordering","reason":"A fast `Stop` could race ahead of a slower `PostToolUse` for the same turn."}]},{"title":"Install the bridge with `omp plugin link` on the package root","rationale":"`omp plugin link` symlinks the directory into `~/.omp/plugins/node_modules/entirecontext-omp`, so the same package root also exposes `.mcp.json`; the `omp-plugins` capability provider scans `.mcp.json` under enabled npm/link plugin roots. The install script first backs up and removes any pre-existing native extension at `<agent-dir>/extensions/entirecontext`, moving it to `<agent-dir>/extensions-backup/` outside the scanned directory, because the loader scans one level deep for `subdir/index.ts` or `subdir/package.json`.","scope":"integrations/omp/install.sh, integrations/omp/.mcp.json","rejected_alternatives":[{"alternative":"Raw symlink into `~/.omp/agent/extensions`","reason":"It loads the extension but never `.mcp.json`."},{"alternative":"Keep the earlier manual-copy install at `<agent-dir>/extensions/entirecontext` (or park a renamed backup inside `extensions/`)","reason":"It is a separate artifact the runtime does not deduplicate against the linked plugin, so every hook fires twice."}]},{"title":"Fail open on hook execution: bound each `ec hook handle` call to 3 seconds and never reject","rationale":"`HOOK_TIMEOUT_MS = 3000` is EC's own hook budget. A missing `ec`, a crash, or a timeout resolves to an empty string and is treated as producing no surfaced context, so a turn is never blocked indefinitely on EC.","scope":"integrations/omp/extension/index.ts","rejected_alternatives":[{"alternative":"Let a slow or failing hook block the turn until it completes","reason":"A slower hook is abandoned rather than stalling a turn."}]},{"title":"Declare host (`pi`) types locally instead of depending on the `@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent` package","rationale":"The plugin must typecheck without the host package installed.","scope":"integrations/omp/extension/index.ts, integrations/omp/package.json","rejected_alternatives":[]},{"title":"Feed surfaced context back as a `custom` message, parsing the `UserPromptSubmit` envelope rather than using raw stdout","rationale":"The two hooks print different shapes: `SessionStart` prints plain text, queued onto the next turn via `deliverAs: \"nextTurn\"`; `UserPromptSubmit` prints a `{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"additionalContext\": \"...\"}}` envelope (`handler.py:373-381`), so the bridge parses it and attaches only `additionalContext` to the current turn's `before_agent_start` return value.","scope":"integrations/omp/extension/index.ts","rejected_alternatives":[{"alternative":"Use the hook's raw stdout as the injected content for both hooks","reason":"`UserPromptSubmit` stdout is a `hookSpecificOutput` JSON envelope, not raw content."}]},{"title":"Deduplicate repeated prompt submissions by remembering the last prompt per session","rationale":"`before_agent_start` can re-fire for the same prompt (a source-base retry or a resumed delivery) with no rollback of the first firing's side effects, which would create a second `turns` row for the same prompt. The bridge skips a byte-identical repeat.","scope":"integrations/omp/extension/index.ts","rejected_alternatives":[{"alternative":"Keep the dedup state across turns instead of resetting it on `turn_end`","reason":"The guard only needs to cover omp's pre-turn retry window; a byte-identical prompt sent as a genuine new turn (\"continue\", \"yes\") must be captured normally."}]}]
